business_summary: Zhejiang Goldensea Hi-Tech Co., Ltd engages in the research and development, production, and sale of filter materials in China and internationally. The company offers various filter materials, such as automotive filter materials, multi-functional and compound air filter materials, melt-blown air filter materials, melt-blown filter material for masks, and PAF filter materials; air filter, including PM25 air filter, multifunction air filter, cabin filter, aviation cabin filter, and heat recovery ventilation; and general and functional filter mesh. It also provides functional, HD, and pleating filters. In addition, it offers fans comprising single and double sirocco fans, cross-flow fans, turbines, and axial-flow fans; as well as injection parts. Further, the company provides air purification solutions for new energy vehicles, rail transportation, public buildings, and pet life. The company was formerly known as Zhejiang Goldensea Environment Technology Co.,Ltd. Zhejiang Goldensea Hi-Tech Co., Ltd was founded in 1995 and is headquartered in Shanghai, China.
